paragraphs: I'm a systems engineer and I've been building software since 2017: backend services in Java and Spring Boot, web apps with React and automated deployments on AWS.

I like to understand the problem well before writing code, and to build systems other people can maintain. I'm currently going deep into AI engineering: agents, RAG and orchestration with LangChain and LangGraph.
Outside of work I'm a curious self-learner and a nature lover.
